editorial:
Imagine waking up in a world where your boss is actually the man who ruined your father's life. That is exactly where you find yourself with Kôichi Nishi. He is a smart, driven guy who has worked his way up the ladder in a big Japanese company, all while hiding a dark secret. He even marries the boss's daughter to get closer to the top. The vibe is tense and cold, making you feel like someone is always watching. It starts off looking like a fancy corporate success story, but it quickly turns into a game of cat and mouse where the stakes are life and death.

You will really love how the tension builds up during the office scenes. The acting is top-notch, and the way the camera moves makes the corporate building feel like a trap. While it moves a bit slower than a modern action flick, the payoff is totally worth it. If you enjoy stories about revenge and power trips, you have to see this. For the best experience, try renting it on Apple TV or grabbing the 4K Blu-ray for your physical collection so you can see every detail of those sharp suits and moody offices.
endingExplained: After a long game of lying and manipulation, Nishi finally pushes the corrupt executives to their breaking point. He exposes their crimes and ruins their reputations. However, the win is bittersweet. Nishi realizes that by spending all his time seeking revenge, he has become just as cold and heartless as the men he hated. He ends up alone and empty, showing that revenge does not actually fix the pain of the past.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves corporate thrillers and revenge stories.
